results.title: Our opinion: Candidates, issues on Tuesday ballot; be sure to vote
results.description: Tuesday’s Missouri ballot includes state auditor primaries, a new Cape Girardeau County presiding commissioner, Jackson’s hotel tax and four constitutional amendments for voters to decide.

results.title: PM Modi hails passage of anti-paper leak bill in new selfie video: 'Paper mafia will not be spared'
results.description: In a video post on social media, the prime minister said that the issue of question paper leaks had plagued governments at both the Centre and the states for decades and threatened to destroy the future of students.

results.title: 5th federal appeals court rejects ICE mass detention policy (Kyle Cheney/Politico)
results.description: Kyle Cheney / Politico : 5th federal appeals court rejects ICE mass detention policy — A fifth federal appeals court has rejected the Trump administration's bid to subject millions of immigrants — most of whom have lived in the U.S. for years without criminal records — to mandatory detention without bond.
